meta.notes: Forest predictor layer for the ENTIRE Åre kommun on the fixed 167x151 grid (25217 cells). BULK-RASTER method: national NMD 2018 rasters downloaded once and sampled locally with rasterio (no per-cell WMS). species_class/is_forest/nmd_code from the basskikt (Jämtlands län tile); sampled at each cell CENTRE (one 10 m pixel). is_forest=1 for standing forest (species 1-4,6); clearcut 'Temporärt ej skog' (118/128) = species_class 5, is_forest 0. Cells outside Jämtlands län coverage (Norway to the west, basskikt nodata) are null across all fields -- masked downstream by the kommun boundary. CANOPY from NMD Objekthöjd 5-45 m: tall_cover_frac = fraction (0..1) of the cell's ~6400 10 m pixels carrying a >=5 m object (canopy density / maturity proxy); tree_height_mean_m = mean height of those tall pixels (null where the cell has no >=5 m object). Heights are 5 m-quantised upper-edge bins (subtract ~2.5 m for midpoints). No basal-area/volume layer (Skogsstyrelsen Skogliga grunddata is auth-gated).
